rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Let me tell you about this operation's target: the <book(83)>Vodarac<endbook()> high priest, <color(6)>Norb<ce()><thumbnail(275)>.
rows.notes: 'target' for mokuhyou avoids the letter j (objective).

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Norb<ce()> is the man holding the key to coexisting with the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Ever since he vanished, we have spent years searching, but we have finally tracked him down.
rows.notes: Norb is male per character_names_021.json / mission_terms_019.json.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>Normally, contact with the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> needs a <book(72)>Coralian<endbook()> to appear first.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>But the <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> is closing in on this world. There is no more time.
rows.notes: 'Limit of Questions' is the locked rendering of Kudan no Genkai (book 77), per encyclopedia_022.json text_id 77 and dialogue/batch_05943 (wiki page title wins over a literal 'Kudan' transliteration).

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>The only option left is... bringing <color(4)>Renton<ce()> and <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> to the <book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()><thumbnail(276)>, to try dialogue with the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Compressed to fit the 128-char limit while keeping the Renton/Eureka/Great Wall/Scub Coral tag order identical to source.

rows.en: <operator(30110,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Norb<ce()> is the one who can guide us to that <book(79)>Great Wall<endbook()>.
<operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>We cannot afford to lose him. That would mean losing humanity's chance to coexist with the <book(72)>Coralians<endbook()> too.
rows.notes: 'him' = Norb (male, locked). 'Coralians' plural for the species collectively, matching the plural rendering already used for book(72) in encyclopedia_022.json (e.g. 'crustal movement, Coralians and the like').

rows.en: <operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>He is being held for now at the <book(59)>Liman Megalopolis<endbook()> in Siberia.
rows.notes: 'He' = Norb (male, locked). 'Liman Megalopolis' per encyclopedia_022.json text_id 59.

rows.en: <operator(30120,1)><speed(2)>If he is moved to <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> HQ, we will have no way to reach him. So this is our only chance.
<topic()><operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Around the <book(59)>Liman Megalopolis<endbook()><thumbnail(277)>, <color(5)>Dewey Novak<ce()>'s <color(5)>Ginga<ce()> has been spotted.
rows.notes: 'Ginga' (Dewey Novak's flagship, source 'Ginga-gou') is a new proper noun with no prior corpus/glossary entry; researched and listed under glossary_proposals.

rows.en: <operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>They probably mean to move Priest <color(6)>Norb<ce()> aboard the <color(5)>Ginga<ce()>. That is our opening.
rows.notes: 'Priest' for Norb-shi; casual-register title, no locked term found beyond 'high priest' for kousou.

rows.en: <operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Near the <book(59)>Liman Megalopolis<endbook()>, we will engage the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> as a diversion while another unit carries out the rescue.
rows.notes: Reordered to keep Liman Megalopolis before New Federation, matching source tag order.

rows.en: <operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>One more thing: word has come in that the area around the <book(59)>Liman Megalopolis<endbook()><thumbnail(279)> has frozen solid.
<operator(30100,1)><speed(2)>Details are still unconfirmed, but it may be the work of an <book(58)>Overman<endbook()>.
<thumbdown()><operator(30110,1)><speed(2)>This will be a hard fight, but one that means a great deal to us. I am counting on you.

'Coralians' rendered plural (generic reference to the species) though this row's Japanese has no explicit plural marker; matches existing plural usage of book(72) elsewhere in the corpus.

'Ginga' is a new name (Dewey Novak's flagship, source 'Ginga-gou'/銀河号); no prior project glossary entry existed. Researched via the Eureka Seven wiki (Chapter 20 - The Future Is In Our Hands, and Cosmic Trigger pages, which both refer to Dewey's command ship as 'the Ginga'); 号 treated as a ship-naming suffix and dropped, matching the project's existing 'the Izumo' convention. Flagged for orchestrator lock.
'Priest Norb' for ノルブ師; no locked title for 師 attached to Norb's name exists yet (only 'high priest' for kousou, used at slot 19). Left as a plausible casual-register rendering.
